caption: Newanforbi v. Macomber
status: DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE — Notice of Voluntary Dismissal filed June 29, 2026 (FRCP 41(a)(1)(A)(i)); self-executing
defendants: Jeff Macomber, Secretary of CDCR (official capacity only)
causes: Procedural Due Process (14th Amend.) — Policy 19-03 challenge; declaratory/injunctive relief under Ex parte Young
key_facts: Challenges CDCR's enforcement of Policy 19-03's categorical 6.5-year bar after Section 3574 adoption (April 2025). Noguchi cited Policy 19-03 as sole basis: 'only completed approximately 4 years of the required 6.5 years.' No Section 3574 analysis. LS/CMI 5 vs. threshold 11. Form 602 exhausted through 3 levels. Equitable relief only.
procedural_status: Filed 03/02/2026. Early stage. June 29, 2026: Notice of Voluntary Dismissal With Prejudice filed under FRCP 41(a)(1)(A)(i)); self-executing; no defendant had filed an answer or motion for summary judgment; case dismissed with prejudice.
damages: Equitable: Declaratory judgment; permanent injunction; de novo review; DAPO training order; §1988 fees
risk: Heck v. Humphrey (addressed via Wilkinson v. Dotson); abstention arguments (distinguished).
